info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Transportation and Logistics

description.describe_ch:
本課程介紹最佳化之基礎理論，研究方法與實務上之相關應用。內容包含線性規劃，
非線性規劃，敏感度分析，對偶理論，指派模型，網路模型，整數規劃，賽局理論，馬可夫鏈，動態規劃，等候理論，模擬等。強調方法之實務應用。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces the theory, methodology, and application of optimization.  Topics such as linear programming, non-linear programming, sensitivity analysis, duality, assignment models, network models, integer programming, Markov chain, dynamic programming, queueing theory, simulation and their relevant applications are included.  The main purposes of this course are model formulation and model building to solve real-world problems.

targets.describe_ch: 數學模型建立與數理分析能力來評估運輸系統
targets.describe_en: mathematic model building and numerical analysis capability to evaluate transportation systems

targets.describe_ch: 以資訊科技或分析軟體以模擬或分析運輸實務問題
targets.describe_en: information technology and software packages to simulate and/or analyze real-world transportation problems
